Profile.description: Welcome to your profile page. Here you can see, edit or delete all your posts.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.error: Could not save. Please try again.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. The image is resized automatically (up to 256 px). Also used as the browser icon.
settings.logoInvalid: Please choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
settings.siteNameHint: Shown next to the logo at the top of every page.
settings.siteNameRequired: The site name can not be empty.
settings.seoHint: Set the texts for each language. If a field is empty, the default text is used.
settings.verificationHint: Only the code of the meta tag "google-site-verification" (the value of content).
settings.footerHint: Shown in the footer of the homepage, i.e. ©2026 promt84.com
settings.announcementShow: Show an announcement at the top of every page
settings.autoApproveHint: A member whose number of approved posts reaches this value gets the next posts approved automatically. 0 = off. Admins and trusted members (see the tab Members) are always approved automatically.
settings.bannedWordsHint: One word or phrase per line. Posts, names and bios that contain one of them are refused. The accents and the case are ignored, only whole words are matched.
settings.heroHint: The big text at the top of the homepage (the same for both languages). Leave a field empty to use the default text.
